main_measure.name: |forecast|-weighted mean excess short 1-bar return vs coin all-window mean

statistic.name: t of weighted mean (heteroskedasticity-robust weighted SE)

main_measure.threshold: confirm if weighted mean excess short return > 0 with t >= 2; reject if < 0 with t <= -2; otherwise, or with fewer than 300 pooled forecast<0 bars, inconclusive

supporting_check.name: share of forecast<0 bars with next return below coin mean (binomial z vs 50%)

decided_by: Inconclusive: the t-statistic lies between -2 and 2.
reading: The situation is a raw spread below 0 with a negative forecast; the coin's mean is the mean of all its within-window next-bar returns over all its windows; the weighted mean's t uses the robust weighted standard error sqrt(sum w^2 (x-m)^2)/sum w with n/(n-1) correction; the supporting check passes when its binomial z is at least 2 (z = 2.2732).
